top_choice_rationale: P007 recognizes a mature, bounded achievement that combined the formal analysis of inequity aversion with decisive experimental work on reciprocity and fairness, durably reshaping economic analysis of incentives, cooperation, contracting, and labour relations. Its citation can credit the complementary contributions of Fehr, Falk, and Schmidt without claiming the whole of behavioural economics or treating social-preference measures as context-invariant.
